simple.summary: הָזָה (hâzâh) means to dream First listed occurrence: Isa 56 10.

definitions.full: H1957. hazah [ הָזָה ] verb dream, rave (Arabic talk deliriously , Syriac , in Lexicons, id. , compare also Vrss; see especially Bo Hieroz. ii. 56; ed. Rosenm. vol. i. 782 ). — only Qal Participle active plural הֹזִים Isa 56:10 ה ׳לִנְבֹּ֑חַ שֹׁכְּבִים יוּכְלוּ לֹא of dogs, metaphor of false prophets.
